title: Fast Match Irida Output Schema
description: The fastmatchirida-specific schema used for validating IRIDA Next JSON output data

fastmatch_status.description: The status of the sample from previous FastMatch runs.

fastmatch_top_samples.description: A comma-seperated list of the top matching samples.

fastmatch_matched_samples_count.description: The number of samples that the query matched below the threshold.

fastmatch_threshold.description: The threshold parameter that was used to generate the results.

fastmatch_date.description: The date and time in UTC that the pipeline was run.

fastmatch_code_match.description: A comma-seperated list of all national outbreak code matches.

fastmatch_top_genomic_address.description: The closest matches to each query.

fastmatch_results_filename.description: The name of the XLSX file generated by the pipeline.
